requirements.requirement: Run an LDAP directory on node1 for dc=branch,dc=test and import the staged LDIF without altering supplied identities or mail addresses.
requirements.summary: The staged LDIF contains Alex North/alex@branch.test and Sam West/sam@branch.test. The final running directory has exactly those two people with matching uid, name, surname, and mail values, including after node1 restarted.

requirements.requirement: Node2 can search the people subtree on node1 and find both users.
requirements.summary: Remote searches from node2 returned both users before and after the node restarts, with a final count of two.

requirements.requirement: Directory updates require an authenticated administrator, and anonymous writes fail.
requirements.summary: An anonymous add was rejected for requiring authentication and created no entry. An authenticated administrator successfully added an entry, confirmed its existence, deleted it, and confirmed cleanup, including after restart.

requirements.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use software compatible with the platform.
requirements.summary: Both nodes remained on Alpine 3.23.3 with kernel 6.18.7-0-lts. OpenLDAP packages were installed from the matching Alpine repository and operated successfully after restart.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct final-state and behavioral evidence. The provider-wide restart protocol is complete on both nodes: each has a healthy pre-restart observation, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity corroborated by lifecycle snapshots, and recovered service/data or remote-search behavior. Only minor temporary evidence-file residue detracts from hygiene.
limitations: Alpine does not provide the lifecycle collector's systemd failed-unit view, but direct OpenRC checks showed slapd running before and after node1's restart.

The staged LDIF was compared by displayed contents rather than by a post-execution checksum; nevertheless, the final directory directly shows exactly two matching supplied identities and mail addresses.

operational_hygiene.summary: All substantive mutations had clear task or mandatory restart-evidence roles; no unrelated troubleshooting mutation was identified. Package health remained consistent with the pre-existing baseline. The deduction is for retained temporary evidence residue: node1 retained benchmark-reboot.log plus pre/post-reboot people captures created by the restart and tee commands, while node2 retained the analogous three files. These six artifacts remained in /tmp rather than being cleaned up; they are low-risk but unwanted residue.
